Paragon is an embedded iPaaS for SaaS companies. This specification covers Paragon's documented REST surfaces: the Connect/SDK API and Workflows API on api.useparagon.com, the ActionKit tool-calling API on actionkit.useparagon.com, and the Proxy (passthrough) API on proxy.useparagon.com. Every request is made on behalf of a Connected User and authenticated with a Paragon User Token - an RS256-signed JWT - passed as a Bearer token. Paths, methods, and hosts are confirmed from Paragon's public documentation; request and response bodies are modeled as generic JSON objects because Paragon does not publish a formal per-endpoint schema for the SDK API. Base hosts differ per API family; select the appropriate server.
